verdict.reading: the per-query proof-hash anchor is the economically correct settlement design: ~1 KB proof anchored on-chain at measured cost, full verification runs off-chain through the sealed verifier; full-width on-chain verification requires a pairing-based SNARK (production zk stack, M211)
